relations.subject: tool:couchbase-cli-setting-cluster
relations.evidence: Specifies the data services memory quota. This quota will be assigned to all future nodes added to the cluster with the data service.

relations.subject: tool:couchbase-cli-setting-cluster
relations.evidence: Sets the full-text service memory quota. This parameter is required if the full-text service is specified in the --services option.

relations.subject: tool:couchbase-cli-setting-cluster
relations.evidence: Sets the index service memory quota. This parameter is required if the index service is specified in the --services option.

relations.subject: port:8091
relations.evidence: Specifies the port for the Couchbase Administration Console. Defaults to port 8091.

notable_absence.finding: The SYNOPSIS lists --cluster-query-ramsize nowhere at all (the flag list stops at --cluster-analytics-ramsize), yet OPTIONS documents it in full ('Sets the Query service memory quota (in MiB). This parameter is required if the Query service is specified in the --services option.') - the identical SYNOPSIS-omits-a-documented-flag pattern found on setting-alert (--alert-communication-issue) and setting-notification (--enable-notification vs --enable-notifications), suggesting this is a systemic authoring habit across the couchbase-cli doc tree rather than an isolated slip on one page.

cross_component_finding: OPTIONS documents --cluster-username and --cluster-password as changing 'the Couchbase root username and password' / 'the new username/password for the Couchbase administrator user' with no mention of the separate admin-manage subcommand (couchbase-cli.md: 'Manages the built-in administrator') that the couchbase-cli.md landing page lists as its own, distinct command. Two subcommands both appear to touch the same 'Couchbase administrator user' identity (setting-cluster's --cluster-username/--cluster-password and admin-manage) with no cross-reference or disambiguation between them on either page as read in this batch - a candidate docs-issue for reconciliation to examine once admin-manage's own page is extracted.
cross_product_finding: The six per-service --cluster-*-ramsize flags mirror the memory-quota model server:service-memory-quota already generalizes across products/surfaces; nothing on this CLI page states these flags are equivalent to a specific REST field or Web Console form field, so no direct terminology-drift claim is made here, only that the coverage (six services enumerated, all with the same 'quota... assigned to all future nodes added... with the X service' phrasing) is internally consistent.
